title.zh: 耦合多常作用：安定、失控与其速度
title.en: How often couplings act: settling, runaway and its rate

statement.zh: 能到达的最大差别至多是 D·(1 + M)^a，a 是有耦合作用的步数，由自环达到；强度为自然数时，每次返回至少使之加倍：返回频繁则失控，耦合稀少则保持多项式；每个时程都安定恰是 Σ⁰₂ 排中。
statement.en: The most difference that can arrive is at most D·(1 + M)^a, a the steps where anything couples, attained by a self-loop; with natural-number strengths each return at least doubles it: frequent returns run away, rare couplings stay polynomial; every schedule settling is exactly Σ⁰₂ excluded middle.

laws.zh: 时程标出一些步，其计数是第 t 步之前标出的步数：随 t 不减，每步至多加一，至多是 t；计数越过第 N 步的值时，第 N 步起有一步被标出，所以计数无界的时程标出的步要多晚有多晚。
laws.en: A schedule marks steps, and its count is the number of marked steps before t: it does not fall, rises by at most one a step and is at most t; where the count passes its value at N, a step from N on is marked, so a schedule with unbounded count marks steps as late as one likes.

laws.zh: 部分在起始之后不给差、起始之差至多 D、每步进入每个条件的强度至多 M 且在未标出的步为零时，所携带的量至多是 D·(1 + M)^a，a 是之前标出的步数；2^a 至多是 A·(t + 1)^n 时它至多是 D·A^M·(t + 1)^(nM)。条件全部列出时，有耦合作用的步就是这样的时程。
laws.en: With the part giving no gap after the start, starting gaps at most D, and the strengths into each condition at most M at each step and zero at unmarked steps, the carried amount is at most D·(1 + M)^a, a the marked steps before; where 2^a is at most A·(t + 1)^n it is at most D·A^M·(t + 1)^(nM). With every condition listed, the steps at which anything couples are such a schedule.

laws.zh: 一个条件以强度 M 在时程标出的步把水平送回自身：恰在这些步耦合，每次耦合是一次返回，标出的步要多晚有多晚时复现，恰好携带 D·(1 + M)^a；强度与起始之差为正时，它有多项式界恰在 2^a 有多项式界处，不论强度。
laws.en: A condition returning its level to itself with strength M at a schedule's marked steps couples exactly there, each coupling a return, recurs where marked steps come as late as one likes, and carries exactly D·(1 + M)^a; with positive strength and start, it is bounded by a polynomial exactly where 2^a is, whatever the strength.

laws.zh: 一个耦合读 d 在第 s 步的水平进入 c 时，c 处跨这一步至少增加 d 到第 s 步所携带的。按时间次序的链把到达其起点者带到终点；从一个条件回到它的这种链是一次返回，每次返回至少使到达者加倍，R 次至少乘以 2^R；返回在第 T i 步、2^i 超过 T i 的每个多项式、且有所到达时，没有多项式界，不论强度。
laws.en: A coupling reading d's level at step s into c adds at least what had reached d by s. A chain in time order carries what reached its start to its end; one back to where it began is a return, and each return at least doubles what had reached it, R returns by 2^R; where something arrived and returns come at steps T i with 2^i outgrowing every polynomial in T i, no polynomial bounds it, whatever the strengths.

laws.zh: 稀疏的时程标出 0、1、3、7、……：之前标出 c 步时 t + 1 ≤ 2^c ≤ 2t + 1，所以 2^a ≤ 2(t + 1)，计数无界。在这些步以正的强度耦合的自环复现，从正的起始每个有限阶都有所漏，所携带的量却至多是 D·2^M·(t + 1)^M。
laws.en: The sparse schedule marks 0, 1, 3, 7, …: with c steps marked before t, t + 1 ≤ 2^c ≤ 2t + 1, so 2^a ≤ 2(t + 1), and its count is unbounded. The self-loop coupling there with positive strength recurs, so from a positive start every finite order misses something, yet it carries at most D·2^M·(t + 1)^M.

laws.zh: 耦合到第 N 步停止，是说它的耦合都不读第 N 步起的水平：停止的耦合不复现，到每个更晚的步都停止。条件全部列出、每对条件的耦合复现或到某步停止时，时程到某步已安定：有限多对的界相加。
laws.en: A coupling stops by N where none of its couplings reads a level from N on: one that stops does not recur, and stops by every later step. With every condition listed, where each pair's coupling recurs or stops by some step, the schedule has settled by some step, the finitely many bounds added.

laws.zh: 第 m 步一个耦合是否读第 n 步起的水平是判定的。二分“对每个判定的二元族，每行在某处为真，或某行处处为假”给出有限全知原则；给定它，条件全部列出时每个耦合复现或停止，每个时程都安定。
laws.en: Whether a coupling at step m reads a level from step n on is decided. The dichotomy that every decided two-place family has every row true somewhere or some row false throughout gives the limited principle of omniscience; given it, with every condition listed each coupling recurs or stops, and every schedule settles.

laws.zh: 在判定的序列 q 第一次为真之步耦合的自环至多耦合一次，不复现；它安定时 q 某处为真或处处为假。所以这些各至多耦合一次的时程都安定，就给出有限全知原则。
laws.en: The self-loop coupling at the first step at which a decided sequence q is true couples at most once and does not recur; where it settles, q is true somewhere or false throughout. So that these schedules, each coupling at most once, all settle gives the limited principle of omniscience.

laws.zh: 在第 s 步之后、到第 s 行的各行都已在某处为真之步读第 s 步水平的自环，复现恰在每行都在某处为真处；它安定时，有限全知原则判定到其安定之步的各行，二分成立。所以一个条件回到自身的每个时程都安定，与条件全部列出的每个世界的每个时程都安定，各恰是这一二分。
laws.en: The self-loop reading level s once every row up to s has been true somewhere recurs exactly where every row is; where it settles, the limited principle of omniscience decides the rows up to its settling step, and the dichotomy follows. So every schedule of one condition returning to itself settling, and every schedule of every world with its conditions listed settling, are each exactly the dichotomy.

laws.zh: Becoming.Loops 的自环每步耦合，携带 D·(1 + M)^t；Becoming.Closing 在第 T 步形成的回路自 T 起每步耦合，在 T + r 携带 D·2^r。经 gap_le_carried，速度约束每个有这些强度的律中两个平衡的流之差。
laws.en: The self-loop of Becoming.Loops couples at every step and carries D·(1 + M)^t; the loop of Becoming.Closing forming at T couples at every step from T and carries D·2^r at T + r. Through gap_le_carried the rate bounds every gap between two balanced flows of every law with the strengths.

laws.zh: 在世界中：在时程标记之步以强度 M 耦合、起始之差为 D 的自环世界平衡，其位是 D·(1 + M)^a，a 是至今标记的步数；M、D 至少为一时，其位有多项式界恰在 2^a 有处；稀疏时程上 M、D 为正时，耦合复现，位至多 D·2^M·(t + 1)^M，所携带的量没有一个有限阶精确。
laws.en: In a world: the world of a self-loop of strength M coupling at the steps a schedule marks, from a gap D, balances and stands at D·(1 + M)^a, a the marked steps so far; with M and D at least one its standing is polynomially bounded exactly where 2^a is; on the sparse schedule, M and D positive, its coupling recurs, its standing is at most D·2^M·(t + 1)^M, and no finite order of the carried amount is exact.

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。耦合强度 k 是给出的界，时程 on 是给出的判定的序列；条件的列表任意，列出每个条件只在写入 every 的定理中。
hypotheses.en: No axiom. The coupling strengths k are supplied bounds and the schedule on a supplied decided sequence; the list of conditions is arbitrary, every condition being listed only where a theorem writes every.

hypotheses.zh: 速度的定理中部分在起始之后不给差、起始之差至多 D、每步进入每个条件的强度至多 M、在未标出的步为零；二分 RecursOrStops 用到时作为假设写入，不假定，安定的时程亦然。
hypotheses.en: In the rate, the part giving no gap after the start, starting gaps at most D, and the strengths into each condition at most M at each step and zero at unmarked steps; the dichotomy RecursOrStops, where used, is written in as a hypothesis, never assumed, and so are settled schedules.

hypotheses.zh: 对一切律的速度（gap_le_count）中条件全部列出，条件的相等可判定只在其证明中经 gap_le_carried 用到。
hypotheses.en: In the rate for every law (gap_le_count), every condition listed, with decided equality of conditions used only in its proof, through gap_le_carried.

does_not_show.zh: 每个时程都安定：它恰是 RecursOrStops，给出有限全知原则；读作 Σ⁰₂ 排中（Akama、Berardi、Hayashi、Kohlenbach 2004）是引用，未在 Lean 中证明。
does_not_show.en: That every schedule settles: it is exactly RecursOrStops, which gives the limited principle of omniscience; reading it as Σ⁰₂ excluded middle (Akama, Berardi, Hayashi and Kohlenbach 2004) is cited, not proved in Lean.

does_not_show.zh: 上游有复现耦合的回路不推出失控：稀疏的自环复现，所携带的量却有多项式界。
does_not_show.en: A loop of recurring couplings upstream does not imply runaway: the sparse self-loop recurs, yet its carried amount is bounded by a polynomial.

does_not_show.zh: 自环之外，能到达的最大差别是否达到按返回的下界或按耦合之步的上界；给定强度的谱半径。
does_not_show.en: Whether, beyond the self-loop, the most difference that can arrive meets the bound by returns or the bound by coupling steps; the spectral radius of given strengths.

does_not_show.zh: 实数的量（正的强度可小于一，收缩的强度可使频繁的返回不失控）；一个给定的律的耦合多常作用；连续时间。
does_not_show.en: Real amounts, where a positive strength may be below one and shrinking strengths could keep frequent returns from running away; how often a given law's couplings act; continuous time.

detail.zh: 稀疏的自环：一个条件在第 0、1、3、7、……步把水平送回自身；耦合复现，每个有限阶都有所漏，所携带的量却至多是 D·2^M·(t + 1)^M：复现耦合的回路不一定失控。
detail.en: The sparse self-loop: one condition returning its level to itself at steps 0, 1, 3, 7, …; its coupling recurs and every finite order misses something, yet the carried amount is at most D·2^M·(t + 1)^M: a loop of recurring couplings need not run away.

detail.zh: 第一个真者的自环：在判定的序列第一次为真之步耦合，至多一次；这些时程都安定就给出有限全知原则：每个时程都安定至少与这一原则一样强。
detail.en: The self-loop at the first true step: it couples at the step a decided sequence is first true, at most once; that all these schedules settle gives the limited principle of omniscience: every schedule settling is at least as strong as that principle.

next_delta.zh: 自环之外，按返回的下界与按耦合之步的上界何者达到；自环之外，多项式增长是否只取决于哪些耦合作用、不取决于其正的强度；给定强度的谱半径（实数的量）；从进程读出的强度多常作用；独立审查。
next_delta.en: Which of the bound by returns and the bound by coupling steps is met beyond the self-loop; whether, beyond it, polynomial growth depends only on which couplings act, not on their positive strengths; the spectral radius of given strengths (real amounts); how often strengths read off the course act; an independent review.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-12 问回路：“how how accurate can we do that uh what is the limitation do we have losses”，目标是“move towards 100%”；2026-10-16 Ren 称 AI 对“只有回路使差别失控”的读法是对的（“your read on this is right”），那一读法把只在某些步成立的耦合留为开放。本结果回答 what-a-cut-loses 的 next_delta 前两项。读法（AI 的，Ren 2026-10-18 取，DELEGATED-CHOICES D43）：失控多快由耦合多常作用定：返回频繁则失控（强度为自然数、正的强度至少为一时；强度小于一时不必如此），耦合之步稀少则不论强度都是多项式，强度只改变大小；对自环，耦合多常作用恰好决定。只在某些步耦合的情形两个方向都已关闭：只有继续着的耦合的回路能使之失控，这样的回路不一定失控。每个时程都安定是一个推理原则，不是理论对展开断言或否认的事实。数学是标准的：只计作用之步的离散 Grönwall 型界，每次返回的加倍，以及 Σ⁰₂ 形式的排中。
correspondence.en: Ren, 12 October 2026, on the loops: “how how accurate can we do that uh what is the limitation do we have losses”, with the goal “move towards 100%”; on 16 October Ren called the AI's reading of “only a loop makes a difference run away” right (“your read on this is right”), a reading that left couplings at only some steps open. This result answers the first two items of what-a-cut-loses' next_delta. Readings (the AI's, taken by Ren on 18 October 2026, DELEGATED-CHOICES D43): how fast a difference runs away is set by how often couplings act: frequent returns make it run away (with natural-number strengths, each positive one at least one; with strengths below one this need not follow) and rare coupling steps keep it polynomial whatever the strengths, strength changing only how large; for a self-loop how often it couples decides exactly. Couplings at only some steps are closed both ways: only a loop of the couplings that go on can make it run away, and such a loop need not. That every schedule settles is a principle of reasoning, not a fact the theory asserts or denies of the unfolding. The mathematics is standard: a discrete Grönwall bound counting only the steps that act, doubling at each return, and a Σ⁰₂ form of excluded middle.
